what: a second, independent reading of the 271 forms cases (lane ZF's development and held-out splits): a reader that saw each case's view (request, content, context) shuffled and without ids, never the examiner's sets, labelled best / acceptable / too poor / too much forms; ids restored from the key afterwards
caveat: BOTH READERS ARE MODELS OF THE SAME FAMILY, not people: agreement between them shows the labels are consistent between two independent model readings, not that they agree with the owner's taste
quote: the reference level a careful reader reaches on 'good' is the reader's first choice under the examiner's sets: 0.902 on development, 0.877 on held-out (241 of 271 in all)
reasons: the reader's 'why' sentence is kept for development cases only: held-out cases carry no text here beyond what acceptance/omni/forms_cases.py already holds
